# 121. Europas Texas, 60 höns och räntespöket

**Feed**: borssurr  
**Published**: 2026-09-11  
**Market Sentiment**: Mixed

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

The hosts, Gabriel Mellqvist and Henrik Mittelman, contrast strong equity markets with growing bond-market worry about rate hikes, inflation, heavy government debt and $100 oil, and draw a parallel to 1994. On stocks they favour structural winners in mining equipment, copper, power and cable build-out: Epiroc, Sandvik, Fortum, NKT and Linjemontage. They treat Finland as 'Europe's Texas' after Google's large investment and power deal with Fortum. They are cautious on Hemnet after it scrapped its buyback, and on real estate, which they see as cheap but lacking a catalyst. They also discuss the SKF split, Octave, Scandi Standard, the Kinnevik turnaround talk and the Dormi IPO.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟢 EPI-A — Epiroc | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 70%

Q2 organic orders up 13% and shares up 30% in a year. Benefits structurally from copper and mining demand, and has Wallenberg as a strong owner.

#### Reasoning

Both hosts say Epiroc and Sandvik are 'stocks you should own right now' given record copper prices and mining capex. Over a long horizon, one host calls buying Epiroc 'given' (självklart), and a strong owner offers downside support. One host admits he doesn't know whether to own it, and Sandvik is seen as the slightly sharper of the two.

#### Sell Triggers

- if copper prices and mining capex reverse
- if Epiroc keeps losing market share to Sandvik
- if order intake turns negative

> *"Då känns det ju givet att köpa Epiroc."*

---

### 🟢 SAND — Sandvik | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 70%

Up 58% in a year with price targets raised. Said to be taking market share, and the rerating is seen as justified.

#### Reasoning

The host says Sandvik is perceived as sharper than Epiroc and is gaining share in mining equipment during the copper boom. The talk in town is that the rerating is correct and that Sandvik now outperforms Atlas. Both hosts see it as a stock to own.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the commodity cycle turns
- if market-share gains stall
- if valuation outruns earnings

> *"Men jag tror båda går väldigt bra och båda är aktier man ska äga i det här läget."*

---

### 🟠 SKF-B — SKF | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Split announced. Lundgren says the stock is highly valued and that spin-off shares are often pushed down, so the buying opportunity may come after the split.

#### Reasoning

The host likes break-ups in general. The cited manager, Lasse Lundgren, warns that SKF is richly valued and that institutions often sell one of the parts after a split, so the entry point may come after the spin-off.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the split is delayed
- if valuation stays high after the spin-off

> *"så att det kan vara köptillfälle, kanske efter avknoppningen, inte innan"*

---

### 🟢 FORTUM — Fortum | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 65%

Google power deal at €80/MWh, well above current prices. A stable utility with structural power build-out; up 20% in a week and 66% in a year.

#### Reasoning

The host calls Fortum typically the kind of stock you should own: steady and regular, plus a long-term structural build-out in electricity demand from AI data centres. The Google contract locks in premium pricing through 2030. The host notes the sharp short-term jump is unusual for this kind of stock, which means some near-term risk. The oil shock is also seen as supporting alternative energy.

#### Sell Triggers

- if power prices collapse
- if more data-centre deals fail to materialise
- if the stock is overextended after its sharp run-up

> *"En bra, typiskt sånt, jag tror man ska äga."*

---

### 🟢 SCST — Scandi Standard | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 65%

Portuguese major owner Grupo Lusiaves keeps buying shares; chicken consumption is a global megatrend; up 52% so far this year; now making acquisitions.

#### Reasoning

The host says the ongoing buying by the large institutional owner is the reason to own the stock, and easier to follow than chicken-farming operations. Rising chicken consumption is a global megatrend. The host admits he was wrong earlier to call the stock expensive. Risks include animal-welfare press coverage and dilution from the new share issue.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the major owner stops buying or sells
- if new animal-welfare scandals emerge
- if acquisitions or the new share issue destroy value

> *"Det är därför man ska äga aktien, tycker jag. En stor institutionell ägare som bara ligger och tuggar i sig."*

---

### ⛔ HEM — Hemnet | **AVOID** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Down 7-8% after scrapping its buyback. Debt-funded buybacks, a clearly declining earnings trend, possibly priced itself out, rising competition.

#### Reasoning

The hosts see stopping the buyback as a sign of trouble. Earnings are clearly declining, Hemnet may have priced itself out, and competition is growing from Booli, Hemmeli and a new Erik Selin venture. One host partly frames dropping buybacks in favour of investment as healthy, so conviction is limited.

#### Sell Triggers

- if earnings trend stabilises
- if Hemnet regains market share through investment

> *"Det går ju sämre för Hemnet."*

---

### 🟠 NKT — NKT | **WATCH** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 55%

Cable and electrification play, down from its late-May peak. 'A bit too expensive but very exciting'; capital markets day in a few weeks.

#### Reasoning

The host likes the grid and cable build-out theme (Fortum/Google, Linjemontage) but finds NKT a bit too expensive. The recent pullback and the upcoming capital markets day make it one to watch rather than buy outright.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the capital markets day disappoints
- if the grid investment cycle slows

> *"lite för dyr men väldigt spännande aktie"*

---

### 🟠 SAGA-B — Sagax | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 40%

Getting new broker recommendations after doing deals. Property stocks trade at a big discount and could hedge inflation, but there is no near-term catalyst.

#### Reasoning

Property is seen as cheap relative to net asset value and useful as an inflation hedge in a 'secular bond bear' scenario. Deals being done at book value support the reported asset values. But the host says money flows trump valuation, and they give up hope of a quick turnaround.

#### Sell Triggers

- if rates keep rising sharply
- if transactions happen below book values

> *"din kompis Sagax börjar rekommenderas"*

---

### 🟠 KINV-B — Kinnevik | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 40%

'Everyone loves Kinnevik' with new recommendations after a long slump, but possibly mostly hot air so far. Henrik would not hold it in a 40-year portfolio.

#### Reasoning

One host notes renewed interest in the stock and the potential for a turnaround after years in the wilderness. The other rejects it for a long-term portfolio, apart from a small innovation sleeve. The view is mixed and speculative.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the renewed interest fades without results
- if portfolio company valuations fall

> *"Alla älskar Kinnevik. Det kommer rekommendationer."*
